import hashlib,json,struct,subprocess,os
mp={}
for line in open('store/jobs/j000018/out/notepad-map.txt'):
 a=line.split()
 if len(a)>=4 and a[0].startswith('0x'):
  try: mp[int(a[0],16)]=int(a[3],16)
  except: pass
f=open('store/jobs/j000018/out/pid.5372.dmp','rb')
def readva(addr,n):
 out=b''
 while n:
  pg=addr&~0xfff
  if pg not in mp: raise KeyError(hex(addr))
  k=min(n,0x1000-(addr-pg));f.seek(mp[pg]+addr-pg);x=f.read(k)
  if len(x)!=k: raise EOFError
  out+=x;addr+=k;n-=k
 return out
# EDIT window desktop pointer chain, derived from captured GUI structure
wrapper=0x1ea80b402b0
editstate=struct.unpack('<Q',readva(wrapper,8))[0]
state=readva(editstate,0x40)
hlocal=struct.unpack_from('<Q',state,0)[0]
textlen=struct.unpack_from('<I',state,0x10)[0]
# A movable HLOCAL is an address of a handle-table slot containing its block pointer.
textptr=struct.unpack('<Q',readva(hlocal,8))[0]
raw=readva(textptr,textlen*2)
text=raw.decode('utf-16le')
res={'wrapper_va':hex(wrapper),'editstate_va':hex(editstate),'hwnd':hex(struct.unpack('<Q',readva(editstate+0x40,8))[0]),'hlocal':hex(hlocal),'textptr':hex(textptr),'length_chars':textlen,'text_repr':repr(text),'utf16le_hex':raw.hex(),'md5_utf8':hashlib.md5(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'tests':[]}
for arc in ['store/jobs/j000154/out/cache-patched.7z','store/jobs/j000160/out/candidate_446443820.7z']:
 for label,pw in [('exact17',text),('rstrip',text.rstrip())]:
  p=subprocess.run(['7z','t','-p'+pw,arc],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
  res['tests'].append({'archive':arc,'password_form':label,'exit':p.returncode,'success':('Everything is Ok' in p.stdout),'stdout_tail':p.stdout[-500:],'stderr_tail':p.stderr[-500:]})
json.dump(res,open(os.environ['OUT']+'/edit-text.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(res,indent=2))
